news.contents: Washington Commanders running back Rachaad White had a quiet outing in Week 9's loss to the Rams, handling seven carries for 28 yards and adding two catches (three targets) for 41 yards. White was surprisingly outtouched by Austin Ekeler 10 to nine in this game, though Ekeler was much less productive with only 34 yards to White's 69. Washington's rushing attack is rated near the bottom of the league by most numbers this season, with a struggling offensive line that ranks 32nd in ESPN's run block...

news.analysis: Jefferson is one of the league's top talents at wide receiver. Still, the Vikings' inept quarterback play so far this season has turned the All-Pro into an inconsistent, boom-or-bust asset for fantasy managers. Jefferson is in the low-end WR2 discussion at present, but if the Vikings can figure things out at QB, he would fly back up the rankings.
